answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a sunk fee of 60 credits, never refunded. The fee funds a public atlas listing each identity with its payment trail, so a farm of look-alikes shows as one cluster. Like rain vanishing into karst, a fake that pays and earns nothing dissolves. Faking 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits up front; one honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its full share, undiluted by the dune of fakes that never pays off.
